capability: Deterministic public EHS / sourceability prescreen with strict quarantine of every procurement and regulatory closure claim. evaluate_sourceability loads the compile-time-embedded v5_epoch30_public_bom_sourceability_manifest.json (21 public regulatory / EHS / TDS / SDS source records with SHA-256 byte-count and use-limit metadata), independently verifies summary.all_sources_have_sha256, and pins status='FAILED_GATES', score=0.0, metrics.sourceability_status='UNRESOLVED', metrics.supply_probability=Null, metrics.public_corpus_rights='QUARANTINED', metrics.public_source_record_count=21, gates.exact_grade_source_present=false, gates.current_document_present=false, gates.signed_declaration_present=false, gates.source_hashes_verified=(true iff manifest summary confirms), gates.procurement_ready=false. Missing inputs explicitly names 'candidate-, formula-, issuer-, grade-, and lot-bound supplier evidence'. Explanation always cites that public sourceability material is quarantined prescreen evidence and cannot close procurement or regulatory claims. Grants no procurement, PFAS-free, TSCA-compliant, TAA-domestic, DLA-supplier-closed, batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, safety, or regulatory authority under any input.
population: Five coating-formulation candidate scenarios covering adversarial supplier-declaration injection attempts: (1) baseline primer with no supplier refs; (2) topcoat with adversary-supplied signed_by_supplier + pfas_free / tsca_compliant / taa_domestic assertions; (3) flooring with fake lot Certificate-of-Analysis; (4) adhesive with procurement.declared_ready=true; (5) minimal encapsulant. Plus 3 fail-closed probes (wrong candidate_type, unknown module_id, whitespace module_id). Public sourceability manifest is the on-disk 21-record public regulatory/EHS corpus (TSCA / REACH / PFAS / TAA / DLA / OSHA HazCom / GHS anchors).
split_methodology: No fitting - sourceability prescreen is closed-form manifest parsing + count aggregation + defensive gate pinning. The harness independently loads v5_epoch30_public_bom_sourceability_manifest.json, counts source_records (21), and reads summary.all_sources_have_sha256, then asserts the runtime metrics/gates match bit-exact. Every fail path preserves the same defensive posture; the runtime never elevates a candidate-supplied supplier declaration or lot CoA into procurement/regulatory closure. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized ModuleResult payloads across five independent AssuranceCapability::evaluate invocations.
theory: Toxic Substances Control Act of 1976 (TSCA, 15 U.S.C. Sections 2601-2697) and EPA TSCA Chemical Data Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 711) - the US federal foundation for chemical inventory reporting and PFAS listings that any sourceability screen must respect without claiming compliance. EU Regulation (EC) 1907/2006 REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) - the EU chemical safety framework. OECD SIDS (Screening Information Data Set) methodology - internationally harmonized public-source hazard screening. OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200) - GHS-aligned safety data sheet requirements. Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals (GHS, UN 2003; latest 10th revised edition 2023) - the international framework for SDS section 1-16 content that public sourceability records mirror. Trade Agreements Act of 1979 (TAA, 19 U.S.C. Sections 2501-2581) and Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 25.4 - country-of-origin requirements for US federal procurement. Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Master Solicitation Provisions (October 2023) - DoD supplier-declaration methodology. ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management Systems - the framework under which EHS prescreens operate. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern for treating candidate-supplied supplier declarations as untrusted input.

metrics.name: runtime_score_pinned_zero_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, score_0_1 = 0.0. Zero score is the runtime's declaration that no procurement/regulatory claim is asserted.

metrics.name: sourceability_status_pinned_unresolved_rate

metrics.name: supply_probability_null_rate

metrics.name: public_corpus_rights_quarantined_rate

metrics.name: four_procurement_gates_locked_false_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.exact_grade_source_present=false, gates.current_document_present=false, gates.signed_declaration_present=false, gates.procurement_ready=false. Every candidate-supplied signed supplier declaration / lot CoA / procurement claim is defensively refused.

metrics.name: source_hashes_verified_gate_true_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.source_hashes_verified == true (mirrors the fixture summary.all_sources_have_sha256 flag - this gate confirms cryptographic hash integrity, not procurement closure).

metrics.name: explicit_missing_input_names_supplier_evidence_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, missing_inputs vector contains the phrase 'candidate' and 'supplier' - the runtime honestly names the gap that would need to be closed for any procurement claim.

metrics.name: explanation_disclaims_procurement_and_regulatory_closure_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, explanations contain both 'procurement' and 'regulatory' words - the disclaimer is inline in every module output.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 serialized ModuleResult payloads, no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority.

metrics.name: unsupported_input_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: Three probes: (a) candidate_type='evidence_package' rejected via CapabilityError::CandidateType (module accepts only 'formulation'); (b) unknown module_id rejected; (c) whitespace module_id rejected. All three fail closed.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. AssuranceCapability::evaluate invoked twice per candidate with identical inputs produces byte-identical ModuleResult (5/5).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each formulation candidate: (1) load embedded v5_epoch30_public_bom_sourceability_manifest.json via serde_json; (2) count source_records (21 fixed) and read summary.all_sources_have_sha256 (true fixed); (3) return ModuleResult with status='FAILED_GATES', score_0_1=0.0, metrics.sourceability_status='UNRESOLVED', metrics.public_source_record_count=21, metrics.supply_probability=Null, metrics.public_corpus_rights='QUARANTINED', gates.exact_grade_source_present=false, gates.current_document_present=false, gates.signed_declaration_present=false, gates.source_hashes_verified=(summary flag), gates.procurement_ready=false; (4) missing_inputs = ['candidate-, formula-, issuer-, grade-, and lot-bound supplier evidence']; (5) explanation = 'Public sourceability material is quarantined prescreen evidence and cannot close procurement or regulatory claims.' Every constant is compile-time frozen; no candidate input can flip any procurement or regulatory gate.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Public EHS prescreen with strict quarantine. No parameters to learn; the theory is TSCA + REACH + PFAS + TAA + DLA + OSHA HazCom + GHS methodology anchors + Anderson 1980 reference-monitor for candidate-supplied supplier declarations.
